newsitem.title: CANADA: Rogers denies Cantel sale plan reports.
newsitem.headline: Rogers denies Cantel sale plan reports.

text.p: Rogers Communications Inc denied newspaper reports which said it was set to sell 20 to 33-1/3 percent of Rogers Cantel Mobile Communications Inc to AT&T Canada.
"We haven't any intention now or for the foreseeable future of selling any such block of Cantel," said president and chief executive Ted Rogers in a statement.

"We have made no secret of the fact that we are talking to a number of telecommunications entities concerning possible relationships and alliances. But no such sale of equity is contemplated," he added.
Newspapers have quoted unnamed sources as saying that cash-strapped Rogers has been in talks for about a year on a deal which would see AT&T Canada take up to one-third of Cantel's equity.
According to one newspaper report, the announcement may come at Rogers' investment conference on November 13.
Officials at Rogers were not immediately available for comment.
